info.name: Task 2 - POST /api/apply-promo-code
info.description: Generated from the same cases.json as the Java tests and the test-case spreadsheet. Start the reference service: ./mvnw compile exec:java (port 8080), or point baseUrl at a real environment.

item.name: 1. Discount and totals
PC-01.1 SAVE10 (10 %) on one physical item of 50.00: discount 5.00, free shipping, total 45.00

exec: pm.test('message', function () { pm.expect(result.message).to.eql("Promo code applied successfully"); });
